0022600040.text: The Golden State Warriors (8-4, 2nd in the Pacific and 6th in the West, with an 8-2 last ten and a 2-3 road record) visit the San Antonio Spurs (10-2, 1st in the Southwest and 2nd in the West, on a 10-game winning streak and 6-0 on the road). The Warriors are without Brandon Williams (hamstring), Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry is day-to-day with abdominal soreness and a game-time decision, while the Spurs are missing Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Warriors' most recent meeting was a 127-113 loss to San Antonio in San Francisco on April 1, 2026; the two teams have no games yet this season.
